descriptionMarkdown: Two blueprints, one base version, second with a bit of decorations. Production is connected to storage chests with default settings for how much of everything to craft, that can be changed through constant combinator in upper left corner of blueprint. Green circuit shows the storage, red circuit shows the crafting demand (or surplus). Both blueprints are set up to work in 96x96 grid and take half of the space. All connections to mall are tagged with displays, steel/copper, stone/bricks and green/red circuit belts need to be connected with respected order.
title: Mall for Nauvis - early to mid game
